summary: Appends an actor node a2 to a singly-linked list managed by this. Sets bit 3 in the node's flag dword at +0x3C and clears its forward link at +0x4C, then registers the node with TreeNodeAccumulator(this, a2). When the list head at this+0x108 is non-null the node is appended to the tail via the +0x4C forward links; otherwise it becomes the new head. The node's backward link at +0x48 is set to the previous tail, or cleared when the node becomes the head.

operations.description: Set bit 3 in the node's flag dword: v2 = a2[15] | 8 at node+0x3C.
Clear the node's forward link at +0x4C (a2[19] = 0) before insertion.
Register the node with the tree accumulator: TreeNodeAccumulator(this, a2).
Read the list head at this+0x108; when it is non-null append to the tail, otherwise make the new node the head.
Walk to the list tail following the +0x4C forward links; the extraction derives this chain through the base at this+0x154.
Append: set the tail's +0x4C forward link to the new node and set the new node's +0x48 backward link to the old tail.
Empty-list path: store the new node as head at this+0x108 and clear its +0x48 backward link.
Return the accumulator result (or the last walked value).
